limitation: Singleton separability uses a different decomposition at each cut; it does not imply full separability, larger-cut PPT or genuine high entanglement depth. The stationary state is two-producible, so its distance to that set is zero even as distance to fully separable states tends to one. Multipartite bound entanglement here does not resolve bipartite NPT bound entanglement.
